operation.summary: Change this Bridgit's half of one direction: in = the other Bridgit uses this one (services), out = this one uses it (agents); paused on either; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: services
body.description: in only: the service list (what the other Bridgit may use here); [] leaves only the link itself

body.name: agents
body.description: out only: this Bridgit's control agent ids that may use the other one; setting it is this Bridgit's opt-in

body.name: paused
body.description: Pause or resume this direction on this Bridgit

operation.returns: the link (id, name, bridgit_name, target, sat_id, role, in{state, services, granter, paused, revoked, other_side}, out{state, agents[{id,name}], granter, paused, revoked, services, other_side}, disconnecting{direction, undo_until})

paused.description: Pause or resume this direction on this Bridgit

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

services.description: in only: the service list (what the other Bridgit may use here); [] leaves only the link itself

agents.description: out only: this Bridgit's control agent ids that may use the other one; setting it is this Bridgit's opt-in
